name: agent-usage
description: Monitor Claude and Codex plan usage for every signed-in profile in the Explorer sidebar and status bar.

agentUsageBar.refreshIntervalMinutes.description: How often to poll the usage endpoint.

agentUsageBar.warnAtPercent.description: Highlight the status bar item (warning colour) when any limit reaches this percentage.

agentUsageBar.errorAtPercent.description: Highlight the status bar item (error colour) when any limit reaches this percentage.

agentUsageBar.showStatusBarItem.description: Also show the compact summary in the status bar.

agentUsageBar.claude.configDirectory.description: Extra Claude config directory to monitor besides the signed-in ~/.claude and ~/.claude-* profiles found automatically (and CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR when set).

agentUsageBar.providers.description: Providers to monitor. Select one, both, or none.

agentUsageBar.codex.home.description: Extra Codex home directory to monitor besides the signed-in ~/.codex and ~/.codex-* homes found automatically (and CODEX_HOME when set).

agentUsageBar.codex.executablePath.description: Codex CLI executable name or absolute path. Used to read account limits through the local app server.

claudeUsageBar.refreshIntervalMinutes.description: How often to poll the usage endpoint.
claudeUsageBar.refreshIntervalMinutes.deprecationMessage: Use agentUsageBar.refreshIntervalMinutes. Existing values remain a fallback until the new setting is configured.

claudeUsageBar.warnAtPercent.description: Highlight the status bar item (warning colour) when any limit reaches this percentage.
claudeUsageBar.warnAtPercent.deprecationMessage: Use agentUsageBar.warnAtPercent. Existing values remain a fallback until the new setting is configured.

claudeUsageBar.errorAtPercent.description: Highlight the status bar item (error colour) when any limit reaches this percentage.
claudeUsageBar.errorAtPercent.deprecationMessage: Use agentUsageBar.errorAtPercent. Existing values remain a fallback until the new setting is configured.

claudeUsageBar.showStatusBarItem.description: Also show the compact summary in the status bar.
claudeUsageBar.showStatusBarItem.deprecationMessage: Use agentUsageBar.showStatusBarItem. Existing values remain a fallback until the new setting is configured.

claudeUsageBar.configDirectory.description: Claude config directory to monitor, such as ~/.claude-personal. Empty uses CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR when set, otherwise ~/.claude. Selects matching profile credentials on macOS too.
claudeUsageBar.configDirectory.deprecationMessage: Use agentUsageBar.claude.configDirectory. Existing values remain a fallback until the new setting is configured.

scripts.package: npm run compile && vsce package --no-dependencies -o agent-usage.vsix
scripts.install-vscode: npm run package && "/Applications/Visual Studio Code.app/Contents/Resources/app/bin/code" --install-extension agent-usage.vsix --force
